products.name: Plas Maenan Country House
products.description: Located in Llanrwst, Plas Maenan Country House is in a national park, within a 10-minute drive of St Grwst Church and Llanrwst Almshouses. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Llanrwst? This country house has facilities measuring 646 square feet (60 square meters), including conference space. Free valet parking is available onsite.
